description: Source-only audit of VoiceChat-TTS (arXiv:2608.13831) as a modular continuous low-latency TTS donor for Frankenstein 2.0, with explicit checks for German support, public implementation/weights, local runtime feasibility, interruption semantics and whether source evidence justifies any later target-runtime benchmark.
routing_law: Preserve the continuous LLM-token-stream TTS, explicit interruption-token, silence-on-no-input and KV-cache-preserving interruption mechanisms as architecture donors. Do not dispatch VoiceChat-TTS to target runtime until an official public artifact pins revision/license/dependencies and establishes German support; a later runtime benchmark requires a distinct justified semantic generation/objective.
